sloka: स रावणं वारणहस्तबाहुर्ददर्श दीप्तोद्यतभीमचापम् ।प्रच्छादयन्तं शरवृष्टिजालैस्तान् वानरान् भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् ।। ६.५९.५२ ।।।।
transliteration: sa rāvaṇaṁ vāraṇahastabāhurdadarśa dīptodyatabhīmacāpam ।pracchādayantaṁ śaravṛṣṭijālaistān vānarān bhinnavikīrṇadehān ।। 6.59.52 ।।।।

translations.english: He saw Ravana, endowed with round shoulders like elephant trunks, with fierce bow glowing and the broken bodies of Vanaras spread all over. Ravana was showering nets of arrows and instigating vanaras.
